changes.summary: Validate floating XLSX values against the same 15-digit precision contract as integer/SQL numeric values, preserve calendar dates across midnight DST gaps, and provide decimal-safe percentage-point cells.
Initialize the Redis FIFO test connection before injecting storage failure and verify the intended failure explicitly; production behavior is unchanged.

Add currency-bound non-additive numeric report dimensions and a complete 64-column report budget. XLSX exports now preserve numeric/date types instead of DecimalComma or legacy Go-layout text rendering; migrate custom DateTimeFormat callers to DateTimeNumberFormat or Cell.NumberFormat.
Keep XLSX numbers and dates typed in buffered and streaming exports; add explicit cell number formats and safe native numeric handling without changing CSV formula safety.
